## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation") flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` via config reload (generation 119, applied 02:13:41.234Z). Pool stayed fixed at size 20 but per-request mode couldn't keep connections cycling fast enough — pool saturates (`in_use 20/20`), wait queue backs up and never drains (13 → 74+ waiting, still growing).

**Error signature:**
```
ERROR pool req-XXXXX ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```
Hits all 4 upstreams evenly (billing-svc, orders-svc, catalog-svc, accounts-svc) — confirms gateway-side pool issue, not one upstream failing.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z (first 503, `req-07401`) through 2026-03-14T03:59:27.974Z (log cutoff) — **still ongoing, unresolved**, 530 pool-exhaustion errors logged so far, queue depth still climbing.

**Scope:** gateway only. Workers (`logs/worker.log`) unaffected — clean over same window aside from one unrelated known issue (OPS-2210, slow orders query).

**Rollback target:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, shipped 02:12:00Z-02:14:00Z). Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.

**Note:** two later unrelated deploys shipped during the incident window — `dep-4472` (billing-svc, 02:41Z) and `dep-4473` (catalog-svc, 03:20Z) — not implicated, no need to touch.
